{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Classic (no v-cards)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>classic_no_virtual</code>) using only Decipher-printed cards: set ids 1&ndash;14 and premium ids 101&ndash;112, with no virtual cards. Cards with the Defensive Shield, Episode I or Maintenance icon are banned.<ref name="gemp" /> Forum threads call it "Classic No-V".<ref name="t85240" />

== Classic (no v-cards) (Modified) ==
GEMP also has '''Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)''' (code <code>classic_no_virtual_m</code>). It has the same pool but allows 14 Defensive Shields: ''A Close Race'', ''A Tragedy Has Occurred'', ''An Unusual Amount Of Fear'', ''Another Pathetic Lifeform'', ''Don't Do That Again'', ''Only Jedi Carry That Weapon'', ''Planetary Defenses'', ''Allegations Of Corruption'', ''Fanfare'', ''Fear Is My Ally'', ''Weapon Of A Sith'', ''We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh?'', ''Wipe Them Out, All Of Them'' and ''You've Never Won A Race?''.<ref name="gemp" /> It was used in the Retro League:
